videos.title: Mother's Pride
videos.description: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes and James Buckley.

videos.title: Zoolander
videos.description: A dim male model's career starts to decline and he fails to realise he is a pawn in a dangerous game of international espionage. Comedy, starring Ben Stiller and Owen Wilson.

videos.title: Zoolander 2
videos.description: A dim-witted supermodel must step back into the spotlight when a maniac starts murdering some of the world's most beautiful pop stars. Comedy sequel, starring Ben Stiller.

videos.title: Team America: World Police
videos.description: A global counter-terrorism squad travels around the world creating as much destruction as its intended targets. Puppet comedy, with the voices of Trey Parker and Matt Stone.

videos.title: American Pie 2
videos.description: The teenage friends get together after their first year at college and set out to broaden their sexual horizons over the summer. Comedy sequel, with Jason Biggs and Chris Klein.

videos.title: The Phoenician Scheme
videos.description: A rich businessman and his daughter become the target of scheming tycoons, terrorists and assassins. Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro.

videos.title: Superbad
videos.description: Two teenagers hope to lose their virginity at a party - but to get into the bash they must take booze, which proves harder than expected. Comedy, with Jonah Hill and Michael Cera.

videos.title: Bridesmaids
videos.description: A disorganised woman takes charge of her best friend's bridal party, but the wife of the groom's boss causes problems. Comedy, with Kristen Wiig, Rose Byrne and Melissa McCarthy.

videos.title: American Pie: The Wedding
videos.description: The friends reunite to celebrate Jim and Michelle's forthcoming trip to the altar - but events quickly spiral out of control. Comedy sequel, with Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan.

videos.title: Instant Family
videos.description: A couple decide to adopt, but get more than they bargained for when they take in a rebellious teen and her two siblings. Comedy, starring Mark Wahlberg and Rose Byrne.

videos.title: We're the Millers
videos.description: A drug dealer recruits a fake family to give him a cover for moving a shipment of marijuana over the Mexican border. Comedy, with Jason Sudeikis and Jennifer Aniston.

videos.title: Logan Lucky
videos.description: Two brothers attempt to pull off a heist during a Nascar race in North Carolina. Crime caper, starring Channing Tatum and Adam Driver.

videos.title: One of Them Days
videos.description: Two roommates race against time to avoid eviction after a boyfriend spends their rent money. Comedy, starring Keke Palmer and SZA.

videos.title: Team America: World Police
videos.description: A global counter-terrorism squad travels around the world creating as much destruction as its intended targets. Puppet comedy, with the voices of Trey Parker and Matt Stone.

videos.title: About Last Night
videos.description: Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship after a one-night stand, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Romantic comedy remake, with Michael Ealy and Joy Bryant.

videos.title: Yesterday
videos.description: A musician wakes up after being hit by a bus to find he is the only person in the world who remembers the Beatles. Comedy, with Himesh Patel and Lily James. Directed by Danny Boyle.

videos.title: American Pie: The Wedding
videos.description: The friends reunite to celebrate Jim and Michelle's forthcoming trip to the altar - but events quickly spiral out of control. Comedy sequel, with Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan.

videos.title: Little Fockers
videos.description: A father of twins invites his family to his kids' birthday party and tries to finally prove his worth to his father-in-law. Comedy sequel, with Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro.

videos.title: White Chicks
videos.description: Two black male FBI agents are forced to pose as white female debutantes to protect a couple of heiresses from a kidnapping plot. Comedy, starring brothers Shawn and Marlon Wayans.

videos.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
videos.description: Recently widowed Bridget enters the dating game again, caught between her son's science teacher and a younger man. Romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger.

videos.title: The Wedding Singer
videos.description: A waitress catches the eye of a failed rock star performing at a wedding reception and helps him turn his life around. Romantic comedy, starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore.

videos.title: American Reunion
videos.description: Old friends attending a high-school reunion make disastrous attempts to relive their teens. Comedy sequel to the American Pie movies, with Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan.

videos.title: The Naked Gun
videos.description: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson.

videos.title: Paul
videos.description: A captive alien escapes from a secret military base and seeks the help of two English comic-book geeks in getting to his spaceship. Sci-fi comedy, with Simon Pegg and Nick Frost.

videos.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
videos.description: A racing champion is forced to move back in with his mother after losing his title and wife, and battles to rebuild his confidence. Comedy, with Will Ferrell and John C Reilly.

videos.title: Seven Psychopaths
videos.description: A writer turns to two crooks for advice about a script, but ends up in danger when they kidnap a gangster's dog. Comedy thriller, with Colin Farrell and Sam Rockwell.

videos.title: Grimsby
videos.description: A football hooligan discovers his long-lost brother is a secret agent, and helps him on a world-saving mission. Action comedy, starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong.

videos.title: The Naked Gun
videos.description: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson.

videos.title: The Wedding Singer
videos.description: A waitress catches the eye of a failed rock star performing at a wedding reception and helps him turn his life around. Romantic comedy, starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore.

videos.title: The 'Burbs
videos.description: The arrival of secretive neighbours sparks curiosity in a group of friends, who go to bizarre lengths to learn the truth about them. Black comedy, with Tom Hanks and Bruce Dern.

videos.title: Coming 2 America
videos.description: Pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne of Zamunda. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy.

videos.title: 21 Jump Street
videos.description: Two youthful-looking cops are sent undercover as high-school students to bring down a drugs ring. Comedy inspired by the 1980s TV series, starring Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum.

videos.title: 22 Jump Street
videos.description: Two cops are sent undercover at a university, but their friendship is threatened as they join different student cliques. Crime comedy, with Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum.

videos.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
videos.description: An eccentric but brilliant private eye goes on the trail of a dolphin, the kidnapped mascot of an American football team. Comedy, starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young.

videos.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
videos.description: The eccentric pet detective is coaxed out of exile in a Buddhist monastery to search for a missing sacred bat in the African jungle. Comedy sequel, with Jim Carrey and Simon Callow.

videos.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
videos.description: A blind man and his deaf friend go on the run to escape a trumped-up murder charge and crooks tracking down a top-secret microchip. Comedy, starring Richard Pryor and Gene Wilder.

videos.title: Sixteen Candles
videos.description: A teenager whose parents forgot her birthday searches for the man of her dreams. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald and Justin Henry.

videos.title: The Death of Stalin
videos.description: Political satire following the Soviet dictator's last days and depicting the chaos of the regime after his death. Andrea Riseborough and Jason Isaacs star.

videos.title: Kindergarten Cop
videos.description: An undercover cop poses as a preschool teacher to catch a drug dealer whose son is one of the pupils in his class. Comedy, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Penelope Ann Miller.

videos.title: The Cinema List: Musician Actors
videos.description: From chart-topping singers to scene-stealing screen stars, this edition celebrates musicians-turned-actors, featuring Dreamgirls and Wicked: For Good.
